lines.zh: 我一步步走过岩浆上的窄桥。
lines.en: I cross a narrow bridge over lava, step by step.
My hooves strike the stone, heavy.
My armored joints grind.
I shoulder a boulder out of the way.

lines.zh: 火从我肩甲缝里冒出来。
lines.en: Fire seeps from my shoulder plates.

lines.zh: 我带着一身热气往前挪。
lines.en: I shift forward trailing heat.
I duck so my horns pass first.
My steps crack the ground.
I pass a lava fall.
The heat wave pushes me on.
I stop and roll my neck.

lines.zh: 我的影子投在岩壁上，很大。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall is huge.
I stand, my armor radiating heat.
My breath carries sparks.
I wait, unhurried.
There's a scorch mark on my horn.
I clench and release my fists.
The Nether wind is dry.
I look down at the crack underfoot.
Fire moves inside it.

lines.zh: 我把拳头搁在膝上歇着。
lines.en: I rest a fist on my knee.
The plates glow red in the light.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，像一根钉子。
lines.en: You stand before me like a nail.
I lower my head, horns toward you.

lines.zh: 你的剑刃在我甲上卷了。
lines.en: Your blade has curled on my plate.

lines.zh: 我闻出你身上的味道发苦。
lines.en: Your scent is turning bitter.
One palm could cover you whole.

lines.zh: 你站着没动，我喜欢这样。
lines.en: You hold your ground. I like that.

lines.zh: 我等着你转身跑，你没跑。
lines.en: You still have not turned to run.
I raise a fist, then lower it.
There are fresh marks on your armor.
I score your face into my plate.
A dent is hammered into my plate.

lines.zh: 我撑住膝盖，把身子扳正。
lines.en: I brace on a knee and straighten up.
Sparks jet from the crack.
I grit my teeth and fire bursts out.

lines.zh: 这一下震得我牙齿发麻。
lines.en: That rattles my teeth numb.

lines.zh: 我把牙咬得太紧，嘴角裂了。
lines.en: My jaw clenches so hard my lip splits.
I raise a hand to guard my chest.
Blood and fire mix.

lines.zh: 我甲上的凹痕又深一分。
lines.en: The dent in my plate deepens.
Noted.
Iron? I don't eat iron.
That much looks like nothing.
I'm hungry, but I'm not picky.
Throw it over. Don't hold it up.

lines.zh: 这点东西塞不住我的牙缝。
lines.en: That would not fill the gap in my teeth.
Not worth lifting my hand.
Step back; I don't want to tread on you.
That much heat means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 你想用这个换我放你一命？
lines.en: Would you buy your life with this?
After this, I'll act.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的腿上，弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my leg and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我像一堵墙，你撞不进来。
lines.en: I am a wall you cannot get past.
The plates take all of it.

lines.zh: 你被自己的力气弹回来。
lines.en: Your own force throws you back.

lines.zh: 我脚边的石头被你撞松了。
lines.en: You knock a stone loose at my feet.
I lift a leg.
The path you clear is just what I need.
Stop bumping into me.
That one cost you.

lines.zh: 我照原样往前踏了一步。
lines.en: I take another step just as before.
Hell Barons don't do that.
We only obey the stronger.
It stands half a head shorter. Never mind.
It looks back.
Whoever lowers first is the weaker.
Neither of us lowers.
So we go our separate ways.
I keep this fire alone; I seek no mate.
This land is wide enough.
Next time, we're rivals.

lines.zh: 我把它夹在指节之间看。
lines.en: I hold it between my knuckles to look.
Too heavy? No, very light.
I squeeze and it crumbles.
To me this is like a cracker.
I toss it into my mouth.
My mouth fills with ash.

lines.zh: 我捏起那根还在烧的棒子。
lines.en: I pinch up that still-burning rod.

lines.zh: 它烧着我的手，我不在乎。
lines.en: It burns my hand. I don't care.
I pocket the energy cells.
Useful.
I have counted your footsteps.

lines.zh: 我把两只角对准你的胸口。
lines.en: I level both horns at your chest.

lines.zh: 这一整片，我只看见你还站着。
lines.en: Of all this place, only you still stand.
My hoof paws the ground.
Fire gathers on my fist.
You retreat quickly.
Not quickly enough.
I have you locked. No way around me.
Your gun won't dent my plates.

lines.zh: 我听得见弹头弹开的声音。
lines.en: I hear the rounds ricochet.
There's no one else here.

lines.zh: 终于有人敢站到我的面前。
lines.en: At last, someone dares stand there.
Just the two of us.

lines.zh: 铠甲里全是热气，我等得起。
lines.en: Heat fills my armor; I can wait.

lines.zh: 你绕到柱子后，我撞塌柱子。
lines.en: You duck behind a pillar; I knock it down.
Debris rains down.
Ash gets in your eyes.
I take a step in.
You're running.
Wherever you run, I am already there.
I hold the bridge ahead.
You take the left path; I have closed it.
I turn slowly, but I don't stop.
Your ammunition is running low.
I hear the firing pin click empty.

lines.zh: 火从我的甲缝里流出来。
lines.en: Fire spills from my seams.
You're standing in the heat wave.
Your lips are cracking.
Hold on a little longer.
I'll be there soon.
My shoulder plate slams your ribs.

lines.zh: 装甲肩撞过去，把你顶飞。
lines.en: An armored shoulder sends you flying.
I grab you and hurl you at the wall.
My hoof comes down.
Fire bursts from my fist.
My horns punch through your armor.
That one landed solidly.
You blocked it. Your arm should be broken.
You didn't retreat.
I raise my hand to swing again.
My plates pull apart with the motion.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比你的盾先到。
lines.en: My fist arrives before your shield.

lines.zh: 我这一拳压着你的盾下去。
lines.en: This fist drives down onto your shield.
Then take another.
I close both arms and clamp you.
The punch drives a wave of hot air.
I step out of the lava.
Lava still drips from my plates.
I shake and fire scatters.
The Nether ground is hot underfoot.
I raise my head and look around.
Nothing here worth fighting.

lines.zh: 我踏出第一步，灰全扬起来。
lines.en: My first step throws up all the ash.
My hoofprints sink deep.
I smell iron and gunpowder.
Something living.
I head that way.
Don't block my way.

lines.zh: 火在我身上打转，像回到家里。
lines.en: Fire curls over me like coming home.

lines.zh: 我砸在地上，地面塌了一圈。
lines.en: I hit the ground and it caves in a ring.

lines.zh: 水浇上我的甲，冒起白烟。
lines.en: Water hits my plates and hisses white.
The blast tears off my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸嵌进我的胸甲。
lines.en: A round lodges in my breastplate.

lines.zh: 光缠住我的角，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Light wraps my horns and I can't shake it.
Hunger makes my hands shake.
Lightning runs through the armor.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，火在身后消失。
lines.en: I fall, and the fire vanishes above.
